principles.rule: No project branding, data, media, settings, orders, or authority may bleed across vessel boundaries.
principles.origin: cross-project flash and wrong-project admin regressions

principles.rule: Every startup and route-resolution shield must resolve within a bounded interval or transition to explicit safe recovery.
Operational navigation uses deterministic in-app routes; browser Back is not an operating control.
Every vessel must preserve a durable owner/partner control path independent of Black Flag.
Test, Sea Trial and Private Preview cannot trigger live phone, mail or SMS actions.
Customer production previews must represent the geometry the production process will use; no unsupported fallback geometry.
A customer-approved production artifact remains immutable through review, confirmation, owner/admin and archive.
Refresh preserves the correct authority, project and route when safe; refresh is recovery, not navigation.
Consequential actions leave readable transient feedback plus a durable visible result.
Operational command surfaces are complete in Professional View; Cinematic View is optional presentation and cannot be an operating dependency.
The Admiral may deliberately change Fleet course. Course changes are versioned, promoted explicitly, preserve prior doctrine as history, and remain rollback-capable.
Admiral, Captain, Engine, and vessel mission levels describe responsibility and authority; they never make one project the owner or container of another.
Any fleet member may explicitly adopt an approved capability while its ownership, authority, branding, namespace, and project data remain isolated.

A commissioned Admiral role persists across browser workspace locks and session expiry. Secure re-authentication protects entry; it does not demote the rank. Only explicit server authority revocation changes that role.

courseAuthority.rule: Current doctrine governs the Fleet until the Admiral deliberately promotes a successor course. A new course may supersede prior doctrine without erasing why the prior course existed or which releases operated under it.

currentCourse.heading: Current Admiral course authority, visible doctrine evidence, and measured-storage truth

governance.historyPolicy: append-only; superseded course records remain evidence and rollback references

courseHistory.heading: Production identity with recoverable Fleet authority and committed proof truth

release_compatibility.basis: same semantic contract; exact existing safety predicates retained and negative-tested
